overview_description.description: Runway provides financial planning and analysis software for finance teams and business operators. Its platform supports collaborative planning, financial modeling, forecasting, reporting, scenario analysis, revenue planning, headcount planning, and variance analysis. Runway connects with accounting, human resources, customer relationship management, billing, marketing, and other business systems to consolidate data into financial models and dashboards. Its AI Analyst helps users update models, examine scenarios, analyze variances, and identify financial insights. The platform also supports investor updates, interactive reports, multi-entity modeling, and shared access across departments.
